name: binding-wrap-lock
intent: Four binding strips wrap a card; heavy LOCKED stamp overlays when restricted.

reducedMotion.behaviour: Strips and LOCKED stamp appear immediately without wrap animation

acceptance: Idle: TARGET / Route 07-B visible; live reads unlocked
Restrict: four strips sweep in with staggered delays (0/80/140/200ms)
Done: heavy LOCKED stamp overlays card centre; accent inset border
Replay resets strips and stamp to idle
Reduced motion (prefers or data-force) skips wrap animation
No network; effect stays inside host panel
waveB: Strip count (4), angles, and LOCKED stamp geometry frozen in contract — not colour-only
